subject: Strange stripe artefact in SNP 6.0 data

messages.author: f3cafe66c8d9a87b
messages.subject: Strange stripe artefact in SNP 6.0 data
parts:
Hi all,

I am seeing a strange artefact in my SNP6.0 data when processed by
writeImage function.

>lapply(cs.Plate6, writeImage, tags="rainbow", palette=rainbow(256))

It looks like a small square with diagonal red stripes and looks far
too regular to be generated artificially. It occurs on more than one
chip in the experiment but not always in the same place. I got in
touch with the people running the arrays and they do not see it
through Affymetrix software. So I wonder if this is a problem caused
by aroma.

I can send an example file to illustrate the problem.

Thanks,

Mark

Please do. Do *not* rescale it etc, because if you do, then you can
get funny artifacts that are not true. Make sure to post your
complete script as well (even if it is an obvious one). If you have
some extra information on the data, that'll be good too.

I don't think the Affymetrix can display arrays in a rainbow map,
which could be why they don't see it there. Can you see it if you use
a, say, "yellow" color map. There is probably a simple explanation.
It doubt that there is a bug in aroma.affymetrix generating this, but
you never know.
